meta.title: HawkLabs Nordic — Building useful technology for everyday life
meta.description: HawkLabs Nordic builds thoughtful digital products designed to make life simpler, smarter and less frustrating.

hero.copy: HawkLabs Nordic builds thoughtful digital products designed to make life simpler, smarter and less frustrating.
hero.proof: Building products for job seekers, gamers, pet owners and everyday people.
hero.artLabel: HawkLabs Nordic, an independent innovation lab in Sweden
hero.caption: Curiosity from Norrköping. Useful ideas for everyday life.

why.title: Why We Build
why.paragraph1: We believe technology should solve problems people actually experience.
why.paragraph2: Instead of building for trends, we look for everyday challenges worth making simpler — including the ones we’ve experienced ourselves. Then we build, listen and improve with the people those solutions are for.
why.paragraph3: Our Nordic perspective keeps the work practical, honest and grounded in trust. Curiosity helps us ask better questions; progress means launching, listening and improving.
why.noteCopy: Useful technology should earn its place in someone’s day: less friction, more confidence, and a little more room for what matters.

products.title: What We’re Building
products.intro: Different everyday problems, one shared belief: thoughtful tools can make a real difference.

jobhawk.name: JobHawk
jobhawk.tagline: A steadier way through the job search.
jobhawk.description: An AI-powered career coach to help people improve their CVs, write applications and navigate the search for their next opportunity.
jobhawk.problem: Finding work can be confusing, lonely and hard to know how to approach.

spothawk.name: SpotHawk
spothawk.tagline: Make more of the chargers already out there.
spothawk.description: Peer-to-peer EV charger sharing that helps drivers find a place to charge and lets homeowners share their private charger.
spothawk.problem: Convenient charging can be difficult to find when you’re away from home.

badgehawk.name: BadgeHawk
badgehawk.tagline: Make your team identity unmistakably yours.
badgehawk.description: A creative toolkit for generating professional AI-made emblems, logos and gaming identities for teams and communities.
badgehawk.problem: Small teams deserve identity design that feels as considered as the people behind it.

myfluffy.name: MyFluffy
myfluffy.tagline: A little more peace of mind for pet people.
myfluffy.description: Connected pet technology exploring how thoughtful tracking and health insights can support the bond between people and their animals.
myfluffy.problem: It’s hard to care for what you can’t easily understand or keep track of.

values.eyebrow: A few things we come back to
values.title: How We Like to Build
values.intro: Not a playbook for its own sake. Just principles that help keep the work honest and useful.

people.label: 01 / PEOPLE
people.title: Human First
people.copy: Technology should serve people, not ask people to serve it.

clarity.label: 02 / CLARITY
clarity.title: Simplicity Wins
clarity.copy: Complex problems deserve solutions that feel straightforward.

intention.label: 03 / INTENTION
intention.title: Build With Purpose
intention.copy: Everything we make should help with a meaningful problem.

learning.label: 04 / LEARNING
learning.title: Progress Over Perfection
learning.copy: Launch. Learn. Improve. Keep listening as we go.

founder.eyebrow: A little about the person behind HawkLabs
founder.title: Meet The Builder
founder.paragraph1: I'm a technology enthusiast, football coach and lifelong problem solver from Sweden.
founder.paragraph2: HawkLabs Nordic started with a simple belief: technology should make everyday life easier, not more complicated.
founder.paragraph3: Whether it is helping someone find a job, care for a pet, create something meaningful or solve everyday frustrations, my goal is to build products that help real people.
founder.signoff: Built in Sweden. Shared as the journey unfolds.
